annotation.title_clean: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.title_en: Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Advanced AI system
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (G7 Hiroshima AI Process)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission library page for the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 October 2023). The voluntary, living-document principles build on the OECD AI Principles to promote safe, secure and trustworthy advanced AI, including foundation and generative models. The page gives the description and a download link, not the full text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary guiding principles for organizations developing advanced AI systems, including foundation models and generative AI
Builds on the OECD AI Principles as a living, non-exhaustive document
Applies to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Aims to promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI worldwide
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct for AI developers
